trades.reasoning: Full signal confirmation (RSI 60.2, MACD bullish crossover with rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) meets the multi-signal bar for a buy even on a neutral market day.
Same full multi-signal confirmation as CMG (RSI bullish zone, MACD crossover, rising histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge) justifies deploying idle cash into an open slot.

decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.7%, S&P 500 -0.6%), a neutral session overall. With $889 in cash and 3 open slots, we deployed into CMG and ELVN, the only two candidates showing full 5-signal confirmation (RSI, MACD crossover, rising momentum, price trend, and volume surge), sized moderately given the lack of a broader risk-on tailwind.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today with no single dominant catalyst, reflecting a pause after recent moves rather than a clear risk-off signal. Trading was largely rotational, with strength concentrated in a handful of names showing strong technical setups rather than broad-based sector moves. Overall breadth stayed neutral, consistent with a consolidation phase in the market.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤小幅下跌，NASDAQ跌0.7%、標普500跌0.6%，並無單一明確的利空消息，比較像是近期升勢後的盤整而非全面risk-off。市場資金呈現輪動格局，強勢股集中在技術面訊號完整的個股，而非全面性的板塊性行情。整體市場寬度維持中性，符合盤整階段的特徵。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Instead of relying on just one indicator, traders look for multiple technical signals to agree at once — like RSI in a healthy range, a bullish MACD crossover, price above its moving average, and a volume surge together. When all these align, it suggests real buying interest rather than random noise, which is why CMG and ELVN stood out today even in a flat market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 與其只依賴單一指標，交易者會尋找多個技術訊號同時出現一致的情況——例如RSI處於健康區間、MACD黃金交叉、股價站上均線，加上成交量放大。當這些訊號同時出現時，代表背後可能有真實的買盤支撐，而非單純雜訊，這也是為什麼CMG和ELVN即使在平淡的市場中仍然脫穎而出。
